fatesflipper.cmd.help.verify: prove your Minecraft account to the website for My flips (opt-in, asks first)
fatesflipper.verify.what: /ff verify links this Minecraft account to your Fates account (for My flips). It is optional and runs once, only when you confirm.
fatesflipper.verify.sends: The mod asks your Fates server for a one-use code, hands that code to Minecraft's own "join server" call (the same thing joining any server does; your session token stays inside Minecraft and goes only to Mojang), then sends your player name and the code to your Fates server. Nothing else is sent, stored or kept.
fatesflipper.verify.how: Type /ff verify CONFIRM to go ahead.
fatesflipper.verify.offline: Can't verify: this game isn't logged in to a Minecraft account.
fatesflipper.verify.bad_code: the server sent an unexpected code
fatesflipper.verify.mojang: Mojang refused the check (%s); try again after rejoining
fatesflipper.verify.ok: Verified: %s is now linked to your Fates account.
fatesflipper.verify.taken: %s is already verified on another Fates account.
fatesflipper.verify.limit: Your Fates account already has the most linked Minecraft accounts (3).
fatesflipper.verify.unknown: The server answered, but with something this version doesn't know.
